top_categories.workout_context: The clock runs on selected stages at Muck n Mac Fest. Build repeatable threshold power without racing the transfers between them.
Sustainable 88–92% FTP gives you hard, controlled speed on timed segments without emptying day 2's legs on day one.
Muck n Mac Fest's changing Scottish gravel rewards traction, cadence, and power control that stay reliable across 2 days.
93 miles across 2 consecutive days. Train the repeatable power that still exists after yesterday's ride is in your legs.
Timed stages surge above threshold, then demand recovery while you keep moving. Over-unders train that pattern for both Muck n Mac Fest's days.
Back-to-back race simulations rehearse Muck n Mac Fest's real problem: perform, recover overnight, then perform again.
Timed stages reward repeated high power, including on day 2. VO2 work keeps the final hard segment from becoming damage control.
Controlled threshold density builds sustainable speed for a 2-day event without the recovery cost of constant VO2 work.
Decisive timed segments live just above sustainable power. Train how long you can stay there and how quickly you can reset for the next one.
Aerobic efficiency covers the untimed transfers without stealing the power reserved for timed stages across 2 days.
Tempo is the transfer-day workhorse: fast enough to move, controlled enough to preserve timed-stage power and overnight recovery.
Multi-day volume builds the aerobic base to cover 93 total miles without turning every transfer into recovery debt.

race_overlay.nutrition: Target 40–70g carbs/hour on each of Muck n Mac Fest's 2 event days. Begin recovery fueling within 30 minutes of every finish, replace fluid and sodium, then eat a full carbohydrate-forward meal. Tomorrow's legs are built the night before.
race_overlay.terrain: Mixed terrain at Muck n Mac Fest requires surface adaptability. Include weekly rides on scottish borders gravel enduro to build confidence. Expect: scottish borders gravel, forestry tracks, timed enduro segments.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on TT Threshold, G Spot, and Gravel Specific to prepare you for 93 miles of scottish borders gravel enduro across 2 consecutive days in Traquair House, Scotland, UK.
